findings.reproduction: Library -> View episodes -> Refresh on existing series
findings.expected: Discover and select full source collection without blindly regenerating saved content
findings.actual: Both directory requests HTTP409; saved episode remains readable
findings.cause: Immediate cause confirmed: _owned_collection requires source_metadata.bilibili_parts, otherwise returns the exact observed409 detail. Why historical manifest was never saved or is absent is not established.
findings.confidence: high for immediate API condition; low for historical provenance
findings.affected: One inspected legacy series; wider frequency unknown
findings.recommendation: Design metadata-only directory discovery/backfill separately from model regeneration; review ownership, source availability and preservation of saved notes before implementation. Do not auto-reprocess existing content.
findings.acceptance: Authorized isolated fixture missing manifest can discover all valid parts without changing saved summaries/history, and failure has a clear next step
findings.rollback: Any proposed backfill must use per-row metadata backups and a reversible rollout; no change made
findings.owner: technical + PM, shared with design PR242

findings.severity: medium for affected reader; occurrence breadth unknown
findings.reproduction: Open one ordinary saved summary and load associated screenshots
findings.actual: Repeated screenshot resource HTTP404; previous design audit saw missing-image fallback
findings.cause: Resource unavailable at requested endpoint; file loss, old references and storage routing not distinguished
findings.confidence: high for404; low for underlying cause
findings.recommendation: Read-only inventory of affected references and backup availability before any approved recovery; no model regeneration or content mutation
findings.acceptance: All expected historical images render or accurately identify which cannot be recovered; note/version text remains unchanged
